statement_en: Show that there are infinitely many finite collections of pairwise disjoint intervals of consecutive positive integers, each interval containing at least 4 numbers, such that the product of all the numbers in all the intervals is a perfect square.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_58367 :
    Set.Infinite {𝓙 : Finset (Finset ℕ) |
      (∀ J ∈ 𝓙, 4 ≤ J.card ∧ 0 ∉ J ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, J = Finset.Icc a b) ∧
      (𝓙 : Set (Finset ℕ)).PairwiseDisjoint id ∧
      IsSquare (∏ J ∈ 𝓙, ∏ m ∈ J, m)} := by
  sorry
changes: alpha-renaming only: 𝓘→𝓙, I→J; theorem renamed to a synthetic id; English paraphrased without attribution; tags removed
